SELECT * FROM(
SELECT s.schedule_sq, 'PERSONAL' AS sourceType, NULL AS projectSq, NULL AS companySq ,s.title AS title, s.start_dt AS startDt, s.end_dt AS endDt FROM TBL_SCHEDULE_EVNT s JOIN TBL_CALENDAR_INDVDI_EVNT cie ON cie.schedule_sq = s.schedule_sq WHERE s.schedule_user_sq = #{userSq}
UNION ALL
SELECT s.schedule_sq AS scheduleSq, 'PROJECT' AS sourceType, pj.project_sq AS projectSq, pj.company_sq AS companySq, pj.project_ttl AS title, pj.project_recruit_start_dt AS startDt, pj.project_recruit_end_dt AS endDt FROM TBL_SCRAP_S sc JOIN TBL_PROJECT_M pj ON pj.project_sq = sc.project_sq JOIN TBL_CALENDAR_POSITION_EVNT cpe ON cpe.project_sq = pj.project_sq JOIN TBL_SCHEDULE_EVNT s ON s.schedule_sq = cpe.schedule_sq WHERE sc.user_sq = #{userSq} AND sc.scrap_type_cd = 601 AND s.schedule_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
UNION ALL
SELECT s.schedule_sq as ScheduleSq, 'PROJECT' AS sourceType, pj.project_sq AS projectSq, pj.company_sq, pj.project_ttl AS title, pj.project_recruit_start_dt AS startDt, pj.project_recruit_end_dt AS endDt FROM TBL_SCRAP_S sc JOIN TBL_PROJECT_M pj ON pj.company_sq = sc.company_sq JOIN TBL_CALENDAR_POSITION_EVNT cpe ON cpe.project_sq = pj.project_sq JOIN TBL_SCHEDULE_EVNT s ON s.schedule_sq = cpe.schedule_sq WHERE sc.user_sq = #{userSq} AND sc.scrap_type_cd = 602 AND s.schedule_is_deleted_yn = 'N' ) u
AND (u.endDt IS NULL OR u.endDt >= #{startDt})
AND u.startDt <= #{endDt}
AND u.sourceType = 'PROJECT'
AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_PROJECT_CONTRACT_TYPE_S pct WHERE pct.project_sq = u.projectSq AND pct.contract_type_cd = #{contractTypeCd} )
AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_PROJECT_RECRUIT_JOB_ROLE_S prjr WHERE prjr.project_sq = u.projectSq AND prjr.recruit_job_position_type_cd = #{recruitJobPositionTypeCd} )
AND ( u.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_COMPANY_S co WHERE co.company_sq = u.companySq AND co.company_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_PROJECT_RECRUIT_JOB_ROLE_S prjr JOIN TBL_COMMON_CODE_C c ON c.common_code_sq = prjr.recruit_job_position_type_cd WHERE prjr.project_sq = u.projectSq AND c.common_code_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') ) )
ORDER BY startDt
SELECT * FROM TBL_USER_M WHERE user_sq = #{userSq} AND user_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
